guidetextdraw._value: Under Federal and State Law, if your dental benefits end due to a "qualifying event", you may elect to continue coverage under the plan.  A "qualifying event" is any of the following:
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1589277823131

guidetextdraw_163007575._value: 1. For an employee, termination of employment (other than for gross misconduct) or reduction of hours worked so as to render the employee ineligible for coverage. Last day worked
guidetextdraw_163007575.name: textdraw_1630075751589280087562

guidetextdraw_163007_1835129412._value: 4. For a spouse and eligible dependents, loss of coverage due to the employee becoming eligible for Medicare, date
guidetextdraw_163007_1835129412.name: textdraw_1630075751589280087562_copy_1_copy_1_copy_1

guidetextdraw_163007_2034431308._value: 5. For dependent child, ceasing to qualify as a dependent under the plan, date
guidetextdraw_163007_2034431308.name: textdraw_1630075751589280087562_copy_1_copy_1_copy_1_copy_1

guidetextdraw_2131986784._value: In order to continue your coverage, you will be required to make a monthly premium payment. If you wish to continue this coverage you must return this form and pay the required premium to Wolfpack Insurance Services within 60 days of the qualifying event or receipt of this notice, whichever is later. Subsequent premiums must be paid by the twenty-fifth (25) of the month prior to coverage month. If you do not return this form within the above time limit, it is assumed you have elected not to continue coverage under the group plan.
guidetextdraw_2131986784.name: textdraw_21319867841589280729282

guidetextdraw._value: COBRA is not eligible if coverage is in-force under another plan that does not exclude pre-existing conditions.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1589280835807

guidetextdraw_111818507._value:
If elected, the continued coverage will end on the earliest of the following:

  • 18 months after the date of termination of employment or reduction of hours;
  • 36 months after the date of any other qualifying event;
  • The date the employer ceases to provide any group dental plan to any employee;
  • The date the employee or dependent fails to make an requested premium payment when due;
  • The date the employee or dependent becomes: a covered employee under any other group plan or eligible for Medicare;
guidetextdraw_111818507.name: textdraw_1118185071589281425158
